what-to-leave-off-a-health-page-you-hand.alt: A health-sharing decision checks recipient, purpose, needed information and the submission route.
what-to-leave-off-a-health-page-you-hand.caption: Do not let a form omission hide a relevant care need.

what-to-tell-a-mechanic-before-work-star.alt: Three stages connect a symptom description to a priced diagnosis and a separately approved repair.
what-to-tell-a-mechanic-before-work-star.caption: An approval should identify the job, not just a spending ceiling.

winter-car-prep-checklist.alt: Winter preparation moves from checks to confirmed results and resolved repair or supply gaps.
winter-car-prep-checklist.caption: Observed, tested and unresolved are different results.

available-balance-vs-current-balance.alt: A balance check distinguishes amounts already reflected, commitments still to cover and unclear items to verify with the bank.
available-balance-vs-current-balance.caption: Do not count the same commitment twice.

homeschool-record-keeping-template.alt: Four learning-log fields identify the date, specific work, what actually happened and the evidence or follow-up needed.
homeschool-record-keeping-template.caption: A completed activity is not automatically proof of understanding.

hotel-cannot-find-your-reservation.alt: A booking search separates the property address, dates and status, lead guest name, and provider references.
hotel-cannot-find-your-reservation.caption: Each detail gives the responsible provider another way to search.

the-if-something-happens-to-me-file.alt: Three questions distinguish identifying information, locating it and establishing who is authorised to act.
the-if-something-happens-to-me-file.caption: Finding information does not establish authority to use it.

used-car-no-service-records-what-to-do.alt: Four evidence sources separate recorded service, reported history, recall information and present mechanical condition.
used-car-no-service-records-what-to-do.caption: A report, a receipt, a recall check and an inspection answer different questions.

what-goes-in-a-homeschool-portfolio.alt: Four portfolio evidence fields identify the work, its task, the help given and what changed or needs another check.
what-goes-in-a-homeschool-portfolio.caption: Context makes a selected sample easier to understand.

why-budgeting-apps-stop-working-after-tw.alt: Four budget problems distinguish stale information, maintenance effort, missing commitments and an actual income shortfall.
why-budgeting-apps-stop-working-after-tw.caption: A software reset is not the answer to every money problem.

why-to-do-lists-make-it-worse.alt: Four task categories distinguish the backlog, next action, actual deadline and waiting work instead of mixing them into one urgent list.
why-to-do-lists-make-it-worse.caption: A clear action view can coexist with a complete record.
